headline: Shirpur Gold Refinery Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Shirpur Gold Refinery Limited (SGRL), a BSE/NSE-listed refiner, has formally entered the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, with quarterly compliance filing to NSE. The company disclosed to the stock exchange its status and compliance obligations for Q1 FY2026–27 under IBC framework.
detail: Shirpur Gold Refinery Limited, a non-ferrous metals processor, has initiated the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, triggering automatic statutory moratorium under IBC §14 on all proceedings against the company and suspension of management powers. The company notified NSE of its CIRP status via formal letter dated 21 July 2026, confirming quarterly compliance disclosures for the June 2026 quarter. As a listed entity, SGRL remains subject to stock exchange regulations (Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Rules, 2015) requiring continuous disclosure of material information, even during insolvency proceedings. The Insolvency Professional appointed to SGRL's creditor committee will drive the 180-day (extendable by 90 days) resolution window, at the end of which either a plan is approved by creditors or the company faces liquidation.
